findingClass: the closed-IPO job stops making progress silently — the same (ipo_id, cause_class) pair fails night after night and reads as steady state rather than as a stuck backlog
failThreshold: an identical (ipo_id, cause_class) pair appears in closed_ipo_resourcing with outcome != 'DONE' on 3+ consecutive nights, OR zero rows written in 24h while candidates exist
unverifiableWhen: ENABLE_CLOSED_IPO_JOB is false in the slot being audited — the table is legitimately empty and the check reports unverifiable rather than passing
